text:
mira: Quick triage — we saw a 2.3x p50 latency bump on mixtral-8 when a specific chat template hits. Profiling attached below, but tl;dr: kernel picker is switching to byte-fallback path and KV warmup isn't prefetching BOS tokens, causing lots of tiny kernel launches.

jon: omg, saw this on staging too. repro: `./bench --model mixtral-8x --template 'chat_system_v2' --seq 512` gives the spike.

sam: can you paste the flamegraph output?

mira: paste: ```
perf: top hotspots
  runtime/kernel_launch 37.2%
  tokenizer/byte_fallback 21.5%
  kv_cache/warmup_wait 18.9%
  attention/rope_rescale 9.4%
  io/serialize 5.0%
```

mira: interesting thing — tokenizer produced a lot of 1-2 byte fallback tokens because the chat template includes a few emoji + non-ascii examples in the system role. that bumped token count and changed sequence-length distribution.

jon: so two things colliding: (1) kernel selector uses sequence-length histogram to pick between fused-kernel vs byte-fallback ops, and (2) KV prefetch heuristic assumes contiguous long prefixes to pre-warm caches. when token count grows (more tokens due to byte fallback), the runtime chooses the wrong kernel and we pay the overhead.

sam: any quick mitigations?

mira: a couple: *force kernel preference override* for mixtral-8 in config `kernel_policy = prefer_fused_if_seq_avg_lt=128` — temporary knob. also add small prefix prefetch for first 3 tokens of assistant role: `kv_prefetch.prefix_tokens = 3`.

jon: did you try that?

mira: yes on staging — p50 went down ~30%, p95 down ~18%. But still above baseline for some prompts.

perf-bot: perf-check report: `mixtral-8x chat_system_v2` before: p50 132ms, after knob: p50 92ms, p95 310ms -> 254ms. CI perf test link: https://perf.redwood/internal/1925

sam: what's the root cause then — tokenizer or RoPE?

mira: both. tokenization increased token count variance; RoPE rescales for long sequences which changes attention kernel path because it triggers a fallback for qkv-dtype/scale mismatch in some kernels. In short: rope scaling + extra tokens -> kernel pick flips + KV cold starts.

jon: Model-specific tuning ideas?

mira: for Llama/Mixtral family: lower RopeScale threshold in model-profile for chat templates that include emojis. ex: `rope.scale_threshold=8192` -> `6144` for mixtral-8x. Also adjust `kernel_picker.min_heads_for_fused = 16` for mixtral-heads=32 to prefer fused kernels earlier.

sam: what about Qwen?

mira: Qwen had a separate path — its tokenizer rarely byte-fallbacks so it's fine, but head/kv dims mismatch surfaced on the 4k test where adapter heads were split and caused non-contiguous memory layout triggering slower kernels. fix: ensure `kv_layout=contiguous_by_head=true` for qwen-2b-ltc.

jon: any long-term runtime fixes?

mira: yes: (1) make kernel picker stochastic-aware — include tokenization byte-fallback ratio as input metric, not just seq length. (2) make KV prefetch policy template-aware: if template role==system include prefetch of first N assistant tokens. (3) add tiny compile-time fast-path for common rope scales to avoid rescale jitter.

sam: I can prototype the kernel picker change. what's the metric we should expose?

mira: expose `tokenizer.byte_ratio` (tokens_with_byte_fallback / total_tokens) and `tokenizer.avg_bytes_per_token`. add to routing decision with weight 0.2 initially.

jon: any safety nets? we should avoid regressing other models.

mira: plan: gated rollout — runtime flag `picker.byte_aware=true` off by default. enable on a canary cluster with mixtral models and run perf/e2e tests. also add automatic fallback: if new pick increases p95 by >15% revert.

devops-bot: deploy plan: `canary cluster=eu-west-1, subset=mixtral, rollout=10% -> 50% -> 100%` with auto-rollback on perf regression.

sam: also let's add a small prompt-normalizer in devex examples to avoid unnecessary byte fallbacks (normalize unicode to NFKC for system and user templates). that will reduce token variance across clients.

mira: agreed. I'm opening two PRs: runtime kernel-picker + kv-prefetch tweak, and devex prompt-normalizer. labels: perf, canary, mixtral.

jon: assign reviewers? sam + @perf-team.

sam: ack, i'll review tonight. thanks for digging in mira. :100: 

mira: thanks — I'll post canary results in this thread once deployed.
